svg.title: Statecharts: Incident, Task, Decision, Agent, Deployment
svg.desc: Statecharts of Incident, Task, Decision, Agent (with idle.parked) and Deployment (verified, held) as defined in design/model.md section 2.

g.title: triaging · Incident › open · split and merge are logged, reversible
mitigating · Incident › open · split and merge are logged, reversible
verifying · Incident › open · split and merge are logged, reversible
awaiting_decision · Incident › open · split and merge are logged, reversible
dismissed · kept, scored as noise · Incident
new incident · regression_of = closed id · Incident
open · options, default, expiry · Decision · at expiry: reversible default taken, else re-push once and hold
decided · Decision · at expiry: reversible default taken, else re-push once and hold
applied · Decision · at expiry: reversible default taken, else re-push once and hold
defaulted · reversible default taken · Decision · at expiry: reversible default taken, else re-push once and hold
withdrawn · Decision · at expiry: reversible default taken, else re-push once and hold
dead · any state: pane gone · Agent
idle.parked{reason, resume_at} · quota · api_error · turn_end · waiting · Agent
deploying · lock held, not stale · Deployment
rolled_back · to the last held Deployment · Deployment
